notes: The single written *in* is given to the first `בְּ` only; rule 25's distributed repetition needs a second English occurrence and none is written, so the `בְּ` of u-va-har is unrepresented under rule 40 along with both assimilated articles under rule 29.

`עֲיָנֹת` stands with no preposition on it and takes the supplied *of* that states what it contributes (rule 33); the same word would go to it as a further nomen rectum under rule 19, so the allocation is stable either way.
*flowing forth* keeps its particle with the participle (rule 44); the indefinite articles of *a good land* and *a land* belong to the nouns that license them (rule 15).
